# A credit block dated 2026-01-01, the day INV-001 was posted.
#
# The test gives it INV-001's own posting split, which is on the receivable
# and dated that day, so the only thing wrong with the block is that the split
# is a debit of the receivable rather than a customer's credit.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_credit_block_giving_a_split_it_cannot_spend_is_refused.py.
invoice "INV-CREDIT-DEBIT"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 200
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-CREDIT-DEBIT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 100.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-01
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
